---
title: "Code Fold LaTeX"
format: pdf
filters:
  - gallimaufry
extensions:
  gallimaufry:
    code-fold-latex: true
---

## Code fold removal

The code block below carries a `code-fold` attribute.
In HTML output it would render as a collapsible block, but LaTeX has no equivalent UI, so the filter removes it entirely.

```{.python code-fold="true"}
import numpy as np
x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 100)
print(x)
```

## Regular code block

This block has no `code-fold` attribute and is preserved in all formats.

```python
print("Hello, world!")
```
